summary.ru: (+) will be + V-ing · (–) will not be + V-ing · (?) Will + … + be + V-ing?
summary.en: (+) will be + V-ing · (–) will not be + V-ing · (?) Will + … + be + V-ing?

body.ru:
(+) **S + will be + V-ing**
(–) **S + will not be + V-ing**
(?) **Will + S + be + V-ing?**
**will not** = **won't**
Одна схема для всех.
body.en:
(+) **S + will be + V-ing**
(–) **S + will not be + V-ing**
(?) **Will + S + be + V-ing?**
**will not** = **won't**
One pattern for all forms.

examples: I will be working at nine tomorrow.
She will not be coming to the party.
Will you be using the car this afternoon?
At midnight we will be travelling through the mountains.

body.ru:
• *процесс* будет идти в конкретный момент будущего
• действие будет в процессе, когда произойдёт что-то ещё
• ожидаемые события и планы без акцента на результате
• несколько действий будут идти одновременно
• вежливый вопрос о планах: **Will you be …?**
body.en:
• a *process* will be going on at a particular future moment
• the action will be in progress when something else happens
• expected events and plans without focus on the result
• several actions will be happening at the same time
• a polite question about plans: **Will you be …?**

examples: At eight tomorrow I will be flying to Rome.
When you arrive, I will be waiting outside.
While you are cooking, I will be setting the table.

body.ru:
• **at this time tomorrow** — завтра в это время
• **at eight o'clock tomorrow** — завтра в восемь
• **this time next week** — в это время на следующей неделе
• **all day tomorrow** — весь завтрашний день
• **when / while + настоящее** — когда / пока
• **in ten minutes** — через десять минут
body.en:
• **at this time tomorrow**
• **at eight o'clock tomorrow**
• **this time next week**
• **all day tomorrow**
• **when / while + present**
• **in ten minutes**

examples: This time next week she will be sailing around the islands.
All day tomorrow we will be driving north.
In ten minutes we will be landing in Madrid.

body.ru:
• **by** — к сроку, **for** — длительность; FC важен *момент*, а не срок
• **by the time + настоящее**, затем **will be + V-ing**
• **this time tomorrow** — процесс в моменте, *не* результат
• **state verbs** (know, love, belong) обычно *без* -ing
• контраст: **will be doing** — процесс, **will do** — решение, **will have done** — результат; вопрос **Will + S + be + V-ing?**
body.en:
• **by** = deadline, **for** = duration; FC stresses the *moment*, not the deadline
• **by the time + present**, then **will be + V-ing**
• **this time tomorrow** — a process at the moment, *not* a result
• **state verbs** (know, love, belong) usually take *no* -ing
• contrast: **will be doing** — process, **will do** — decision, **will have done** — result; question **Will + S + be + V-ing?**

examples: I will be seeing her tomorrow, so I can pass on the message.
I will call you when I get home.
You will recognise him — he will be wearing a red jacket.

prompt.ru: Сопоставьте значение Future Continuous и пример.
prompt.en: Match each use of the Future Continuous with an example.

left.ru: Действие в процессе в конкретный момент будущего
left.en: An action in progress at a future moment

pairs.right: At nine tomorrow I will be having breakfast.

left.en: Two future actions happening at the same time

pairs.right: While you are cooking, I will be laying the table.

left.en: A planned event seen as a process

pairs.right: The team will be arriving at the airport at six.
Will you be using the printer later?

explanation.ru: Каждый пример показывает действие в процессе в будущем: в момент времени, одновременно с другим действием или как ожидаемое событие.
explanation.en: Each example shows an action in progress in the future: at a moment in time, at the same time as another action, or as an expected event.

prompt.en: Match each time marker with an example.

left.ru: at this time tomorrow — завтра в это время

pairs.right: At this time tomorrow I will be sitting on a plane.

left.ru: when you arrive — когда ты приедешь

pairs.right: When you arrive, I will be standing by the main entrance.

left.ru: all day tomorrow — весь завтрашний день

pairs.right: All day tomorrow we will be working in the garden.

left.ru: this time next week — в это время на следующей неделе

pairs.right: This time next week they will be sailing around the islands.

explanation.ru: Markers at this time tomorrow и when you arrive задают момент, а all day tomorrow и this time next week подчёркивают процесс.
explanation.en: At this time tomorrow and when you arrive set the moment, while all day tomorrow and this time next week emphasise the process.

prompt.en: Match each form with an example.

pairs.right: I will be working late tonight.
She will not be coming to the meeting.
Will you be joining us for dinner?
What will you be doing at eight?

explanation.ru: Future Continuous: will be + -ing; отрицание will not be + -ing; в вопросе will ставится перед подлежащим.
explanation.en: Future Continuous: will be + -ing; the negative is will not be + -ing; in questions will comes before the subject.

prompt.en: Match each situation with a sentence.

left.ru: Действие уже будет идти, когда случится другое
left.en: The action will already be going on when another happens

pairs.right: When the guests arrive, the band will be playing.

left.ru: Действие будет идти в указанный момент
left.en: The action will be in progress at the stated moment

pairs.right: At midnight I will be travelling to Scotland.

left.en: Future plans seen as a process

pairs.right: This time next month she will be living in Paris.
While I am driving, the children will be sleeping.

explanation.ru: Все предложения описывают процесс в будущем; выбор формы зависит от ситуации, а не от результата.
explanation.en: All the sentences describe a future process; the choice of form depends on the situation rather than the result.

prompt.en: Match each form with the best example.

left.ru: will be doing — процесс в момент будущего
left.en: will be doing — a process at a future moment

pairs.right: At seven tomorrow I will be having dinner.

left.en: will do — a decision or promise

pairs.right: I will call you as soon as I arrive.
We are meeting the clients on Friday.

left.ru: will have done — завершённость к сроку
left.en: will have done — completion by a deadline

pairs.right: By Friday I will have finished the project.

explanation.ru: Future Continuous изображает процесс в будущий момент, Future Simple — решение или обещание, present continuous — договорённость, Future Perfect — завершённость к сроку.
explanation.en: The Future Continuous shows a process at a future moment, the Future Simple a decision or promise, the present continuous an arrangement, and the Future Perfect completion by a deadline.

prompt.en: Match each question with a short answer.

left.en: Will you be working late tonight?

pairs.right: No, I will not be working late tonight.

left.en: Will she be coming to the party?

pairs.right: Yes, she will be coming to the party.

left.en: Will they be using the car tomorrow?

pairs.right: No, they will not be using the car tomorrow.

left.ru: Он будет играть в теннис в воскресенье?
left.en: Will he be playing tennis on Sunday?

pairs.right: Yes, he will be playing tennis on Sunday.

explanation.ru: Вопрос о процессе в будущем строится с will … be + V-ing, а ответ повторяет ту же форму с yes или no.
explanation.en: A question about a future process uses will … be + V-ing, and the answer repeats the same form with yes or no.

prompt.en: Match each time marker with a sentence.

pairs.right: At midnight the train will be crossing the border.

left.ru: in ten minutes — через десять минут

pairs.right: In ten minutes we will be landing in Madrid.

left.ru: while you are asleep — пока ты спишь

pairs.right: While you are asleep, the team will be decorating the hall.

left.ru: between two and four — между двумя и четырьмя

pairs.right: Between two and four I will be teaching my evening class.

explanation.ru: Все маркеры задают момент или промежуток в будущем, в который действие будет идти.
explanation.en: All the markers set a future moment or interval at which the action will be going on.

prompt.en: Match each mistake with the corrected sentence.

left.ru: ❌ I will working tomorrow. — ошибка в форме

pairs.right: I will be working tomorrow.

left.ru: ❌ She will be work at nine. — ошибка в форме
left.en: ❌ She will be work at nine.

pairs.right: She will be working at nine.

left.ru: ❌ Will you be use the car? — ошибка в форме
left.en: ❌ Will you be use the car?

pairs.right: Will you be using the car?

left.ru: ❌ They not will be coming. — ошибка в форме

pairs.right: They will not be coming.

explanation.ru: После will обязательно be, а основной глагол стоит в форме -ing; отрицание — will not be.
explanation.en: After will we always need be, and the main verb takes the -ing form; the negative is will not be.

prompt.en: Match each situation with a sentence.

left.en: The process is going on when the guests arrive

pairs.right: When the guests arrive, the chef will be cooking.

left.en: The action will go on all day

pairs.right: All day tomorrow we will be painting the fence.
While I am cooking, my brother will be setting the table.
This time next week I will be sitting in a meeting.

explanation.ru: Каждая ситуация описывает процесс в будущем: в момент, одновременно с другим действием или в течение длительного времени.
explanation.en: Each situation describes a future process: at a moment, at the same time as another action, or over a long period.

prompt.en: Match each form with an example.

pairs.right: I will be flying to Rome tomorrow.
She will not be coming to the party.
Will they be waiting for us at the station?
When you arrive, I will be holding a sign with your name.

explanation.ru: Утверждение, отрицание и вопрос различаются порядком will, а последний пример показывает процесс в момент другого действия.
explanation.en: The affirmative, negative and question forms differ in the position of will, while the last example shows a process at another action.
